kehillah_missing_parshanut_work_trigger = {
	$LIBRARY$ = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				current_date >= 300.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 250.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mekhilta } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 500.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_genesis_rabbah } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 800.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_pirkei_derabbi_eliezer } }
			}
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_torah } }
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_neviim } }
			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tanakh_ketuvim } }
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_rashi_torah } }
			}
		}
	}
}

kehillah_missing_talmudics_work_trigger = {
	$LIBRARY$ = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				current_date >= 200.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mishnah } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 600.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_bavli_zeraim } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 600.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_bavli_moed } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 600.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_bavli_nashim } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 600.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_bavli_nezikin } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 600.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_bavli_kodashim } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 600.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_bavli_tahorot } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 425.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_yerushalmi_zeraim } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 425.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_yerushalmi_moed } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 425.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_yerushalmi_nashim } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 425.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_yerushalmi_nezikin } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 825.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_halakhot_gedolot } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 300.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tosefta } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 870.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_seder_rav_amram } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 987.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_iggeret_rav_sherira } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 1050.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_rabbenu_hananel } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_talmud_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_rashi_talmud } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_hilkhot_harif_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_hilkhot_harif } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_mishneh_torah_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mishneh_torah } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_tosafot_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_tosafot } }
			}
		}
	}
}

kehillah_missing_hashkafa_work_trigger = {
	$LIBRARY$ = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				current_date >= 400.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_sefer_yetzirah } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 700.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_hekhalot_rabbati } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 700.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_shiur_qomah } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 500.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_sefer_harazim } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 933.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_emunot_vedeot } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 1080.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_chovot_halevavot } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_kuzari_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_kuzari } }
			}
			AND = {
				current_date >= 1050.1.1
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_mekor_hayyim } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_moreh_nevukhim_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_moreh_nevukhim } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_sefer_habahir_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_sefer_habahir } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_sefer_hasidim_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_sefer_hasidim } }
			}
			AND = {
				has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_zohar_written
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_zohar } }
			}
		}
	}
}

kehillah_owns_any_torah_work_trigger = {
	OR = {
		kehillah_owns_parshanut_work_trigger = { LIBRARY = $LIBRARY$ }
		kehillah_owns_talmudics_work_trigger = { LIBRARY = $LIBRARY$ }
		kehillah_owns_hashkafa_work_trigger = { LIBRARY = $LIBRARY$ }
	}
}

# The current work has another already-studied work of the same field.
kehillah_study_torah_has_same_track_reference_trigger = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			var:kehillah_study_current_work_id = 1
			OR = {
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_studied_works target = flag:work_mekhilta }
